claim: Susan Lindauer, a former congressional press aide, was arrested in March 2004 and indicted in the Southern District of New York for conspiring to act as an unregistered agent of the Iraqi Intelligence Service and for prohibited financial transactions with Iraq's government — the indictment alleged she accepted $10,000 for work tied to visits to Iraq's UN mission from 1999 to 2002. Lindauer gave the opposite account: that she had been a US intelligence back-channel asset who, in April 2001, was directed to relay a warning of a coming attack on the World Trade Center using hijacked planes. She was never tried. In 2006 Judge Michael B. Mukasey ruled her unfit to stand trial; a second judge reaffirmed that finding in 2008 after she refused antipsychotic medication the prosecution sought to compel; on January 16, 2009 the government dropped the case, saying prosecuting her would 'no longer be in the interests of justice.'

notes: Group-A substrate only: the prosecution and its disposition are court record (arrest 2004, charged as unregistered IIS agent, found unfit to stand trial 2006/2008, case dropped Jan 16 2009). The reel's load-bearing claims are NOT adopted here and are NOT in this record: that the government allowed/made 9/11 happen as an Iraq-war pretext (Group B, MIHOP framing); that the President, VP and SecDef all had April-2001 foreknowledge (Group B inference); and Lindauer's specific account of a CIA handler ('Dr. Richard Fuse' in the audio — she names Richard Fuisz in her book 'Extreme Prejudice') instructing her to pass an April-2001 WTC-hijacking warning (Group C — no primary trace beyond her own statements). The chyron's 'first U.S. citizen charged under the Patriot Act to silence what she knew about 9/11' is her own framing and is disputed; the indictment charged unregistered-agent and prohibited-transaction counts, not a Patriot Act 9/11-silencing count. Both the DOJ's 'Iraqi agent' charge and Lindauer's 'CIA asset' account are attributed claims, weighed by the reader; neither is asserted in our voice. Not in the EFTA corpus (9/11 subject, not Epstein).
